content: निकायः [नि-चि-घञ् कुत्वम्] .²1 A heap, an assemblage, a class, multitude, flock, group in general; <ls>Mv. 1</ls>. निकाय इति सङ्घात् औत्तराधर्येणावस्थित उच्यते . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 8. 1. 19</ls>; तप्तहेमनिकायाभं शितिकण्ठं त्रिलोचनम् (वीक्ष्य) <ls>Bhāg. 4. 24. 25</ls>. .²2 A congregation, school, an association of persons who perform like duties. .²3 A house, habitation dwelling-place; <ls>Ms. 1. 36</ls>; काशीनिकायः <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 The body. .²5 Aim, butt, mark. .²6 The Supreme Being. .²7 <ab>Ved.</ab> Air, wind; <ls>Vāj. 15. 5</ls>.
